


::: {#def-bipartite-graph .theorem}
# Bipartite graph

A \emph{bipartite graph} is a graph $G = (V, E)$ such that its vertex set $V$ can be partitioned into two disjoint subsets $V_1$ and $V_2$, with $V = V_1 \cup V_2$ and $V_1 \cap V_2 = \varnothing$, so that every edge connects a vertex in $V_1$ to a vertex in $V_2$. Formally,
$$
E \subseteq V_1 \times V_2.
$$
No edges exist between vertices within the same subset.

:::
